summary: Round 45 recheck, 18:14-18:35Z on 29 Sep (21:14-21:35 MSK). No Kaggle calls and no browser; nothing was built, pushed, submitted or committed. exp89t 56669888 was still PENDING at the 18:25:22Z header (L > 9.42 h). The recheck lens is saturated (R44), so the three picks come from the 28 Sep 20:00Z ideas sweep (research/wf_ideas_v4/ideas_29sep). It has 0 recheck hits, and its verdicts came before today's LB reads. (A) THE DIS 'mechanical node bonus' premise: R26-RC-A, ideas_29sep v_15, and the private-risk audit / decision-B reason 'DIS ~0, a public-only lever'. NEW MEASUREMENT on the dummy CSVs. Going from K to K+DIS leaves annotated TP/FP/FN identical (2049/99/78; with CI 2045/107->106/82). DIS removes 1,812 K nodes (matched within 1 um). Only 4 of them lie within 7 um of a GT node, against 28.3 expected at random, a ~7x depletion. So DIS's +0.0009 dummy-lab gain is pure node multiplier, and the removed nodes avoid annotated cells. The ILP S/T identity was checked in the tracksdata source. DIS 2.25 on K gives S 2.25 and T 2.65, and it leaves the fork-vs-new-start margin (Div - A = 0.4) unchanged. DIS's -939 net nodes cancel READMIT 0.94's +1,076 in COUNT only: just 19% of the removed nodes are ones K added. New private prior for DIS: about 0 to +0.0007 (was ~0). Caveats: 4 clips that are mostly 6bba, and exp88a (DIS on exp70g) lost 1 TP. Decision B and the tick do not change. (B) I-384 N1 task-vector extrapolation (v_8): its premise, 'exp89p reads +', was falsified by probe 54 (0.956 vs 0.958). The refutation STANDS on a stronger reason, and the post-deadline k=1.5 note should become CLOSED. (C) MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_Z_WEIGHT (v_4, knobarms v_1): only 0.6 and 1.5 were judged. The refutation's own analysis puts the optimum at ~0.8-0.88, which was never an arm. The verdict STANDS for those values, but the knob was closed too broadly. It is a post-deadline item with EV < +0.001. No finding gives a build, a slot, a submit or a pair change. The evening chain stays as logged.

findings.what: OLD CONCLUSIONS: (1) R26-RC-A (round26/scan_recheck.json): 'the +0.0007 mechanical bonus premise holds only if the removed nodes carry no TP edges on the unseen embryo'; DIS 2.25 prior ~0, range -0.001..+0.0007. (2) ideas_29sep/v_15.json: 'node term about +0.0007 by construction, edge term from ~1.45% ILP edge churn of unknown sign; net sign on an unseen embryo not established'. (3) The private-risk audit and the decision-B reason (CONTEXT 13:34Z): 'DIS is one more public-only lever, ~0'. WHAT CHANGED: new measurement (0 Kaggle calls) on the downloaded dummy CSVs of the exact files. (a) Dummy lab (tools/overlap_lab.eval_clip, 4 train clips), nodes / edges / forks / TP / FP / FN: exp70g 121,252 / 117,083 / 81 / 2047 / 101 / 80; exp85a K 122,328 / 118,137 / 85 / 2049 / 99 / 78; exp89s K+DIS 121,389 / 117,246 / 84 / 2049 / 99 / 78; exp87a K+CI 2045 / 107 / 82; exp89t K+DIS+CI 2045 / 106 / 82. Annotated edges are unchanged by DIS, and the adj change is node multiplier only (44b6_0b24 1.0385 -> 1.0402). (b) By node identity (same frame, match <= 1 um), DIS removes 1,812 K nodes and adds 873. Only 338 of the removed (19%) are nodes that K had added vs exp70g, and exp89s vs exp70g churns +2,524/-2,387. So the net -939 that offsets READMIT 0.94's +1,076 (exp85b/85c split: DIV 0.4 alone +49, READMIT alone +1,022; CONTEXT l.3485-3490) is a COUNT coincidence, not an undo of K. (c) GT proximity: of the 1,812 removed nodes, 4 lie within 7 um of a GT node vs 28.3 expected at the K-node base rate (per clip 0/0.2, 0/2.2, 0/4.9, 4/21.1). Of the 873 added, 1 does. The removals are ~7x depleted near annotated cells: the ILP drops weak short chains (90% are interior degree-2 nodes), and annotators mark clear cells. (d) S/T algebra, checked in tracksdata 0.1.0rc9 solvers/_ilp_solver.py l.296-323. The model has in-flow appear + in = node, out-flow disappear + out = node + division, and node_weight 0 (exp89t cell 4 sets only the edge/app/disapp/div weights). Its cost is (A+Dis)(n-E) + (Dis+Div)#div - sum p. So exp70g sits at S 2, T 3.2; K at S 2, T 2.4; K+DIS at S 2.25, T 2.65. DIS leaves the fork-vs-new-start margin T-S = Div-A = 0.4 unchanged. ILP forks do not reach the output anyway (exp89t cell 7 filter_output_graph l.1953-1998: motion relink replaces the ILP edges, then single-parent/child repair). NEW VERDICT: R26-RC-A's premise HOLDS in-sample on the K base, and more strongly than assumed: the removed nodes avoid annotated cells. The audit's 'public-only lever' label is too strong for DIS. The node-count part is structural: J_adj = J(1 - 0.1(N_pred - N_total)/N_total) is linear (tools/official/.../metrics.py l.412-442), so -0.77% nodes gives about +0.0005..+0.0008 on any embryo whose drop has the same size. The edge side is 0 on this sample. Private prior for DIS moves from ~0 to about 0..+0.0007. It is not a clear positive. Caveats: the 4 clips are in effect a 6bba read (R44-RC-C); the node drop is uneven (44b6_0b24 -2.7%, 44b6_0113 -0.06%); exp88a (DIS on exp70g) was -0.0008 on the dummy (1 TP, 2 FP; R26-RC-A); the old 48-video exp13 parabola gives -0.0007 at S 2.25. The public dd read (0 +- 0.002) fits both. EFFECT ON TONIGHT: none. A >= 0.960 exp89t read now has a mechanism (node multiplier + rounding) and is not a pure fluke, so the logged T1/T2 promotion under decision B stands. On a 0.959 read, decision B (keep exp87a) is the user's pre-registered call, and its expected private cost is <= ~0.0007, far inside the shake-up. No re-ask.
